QB2 1x4 ring is physically a 2x2 square: fwd router dirs per chip E,N,W,S (DPRINT). Straight mcast ranges of 2 cannot follow the ring (turn each hop) -> hang. Only N/S-first L paths expressible as 2D mcast.
host-computed physical route specs: straight or N/S-spine+E/W-branch L; each chip mcasts range 2 in its one expressible direction; readies as table-routed unicasts. LN size lands bit-exact.
